evaluations.evidence: As a anonymoususer, I want to view a list of sponsors

evaluations.evidence: As a trainee, I want to limit to one registration per day per authenticated user

evaluations.evidence: As a trainingcoordinator, I want to have an admin view that helps track registration status for each attendee

evaluations.evidence: As a attendee, I want to be added to a training waitlist

evaluations.evidence: As a trainee, I want to must accept the cancellation terms with a checkbox

evaluations.evidence: As a trainingcoordinator, I want to tie in a cancellation deadline to whatever registration / cancellation workflow exists

evaluations.evidence: As a trainee, I want to add to "my schedule" if there is a schedule feature on the site

evaluations.evidence: As a trainee, I want to see which trainings I have signed up for
